page.title: Heather wool throw at the shop

product.name: Heather wool throw
product.description: It left the cutting table on Thursday after hand hemming, and the batch is wool nook fifty seven.

blocks.text: What you notice is almost nothing after drying, and heather wool is the main thing in the pack, batch iron peg thirteen.
Air the throw on a dry day, which is the right habit for a couch in a cool room, batch birch loft twenty six.
The wash crew packed it in a cotton sack because the wool stays soft, batch river drawer seventy.
